spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact feature surface — the static requestPermission on DeviceOrientationEvent and DeviceMotionEvent plus the secure-context requirement — which is precisely the detection contract this chromestatus entry adds, and the emitted snippet branches on method presence, not user agent.

interactive.rationale: A live five-row probe table produced by real typeof checks, a re-run button, a dynamic verdict paragraph, and the generated cross-browser snippet; for a feature whose whole point is the detection gate this is the right interactive shape, not a static card.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a probe of what the browser exposes plus the progressive-enhancement snippet; both are delivered, with the verdict distinguishing the Safari/Chrome-gated path from legacy direct-attach.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers all three branches (no event interface at all, gate present, legacy no-gate) and probes motion and orientation separately since the two statics can diverge.

references.rationale: See-also links the two sibling concepts only — no https://chromestatus.com/feature/5915984063889408 self-heal link on the page (all three concepts in this feature share the gap).

conformance.rationale: The feature suite mirrors this page exactly (interface exists, statics typeof, secure context, statics-not-on-instances); in this Chromium 141 session it reads 4 pass / 3 fail, the failures being the expected absent statics that the page itself honestly reports.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the probe auto-ran — DOM shows both interfaces present, both statics absent, secure-context true, the legacy-path verdict and populated snippet; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; only the re-run button was not clicked.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts that the probe ran with the observed gate/event booleans plus a consistency check that a reported gate is really a function.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours and proper table semantics, but the default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone, ~3.5:1) and the present pill (--bg-ivory on --accent-emerald, ~4.0:1) miss WCAG AA 4.5:1 at their small bold sizes.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled probe table with scoped headers, role=status aria-live status line, and every state written as text (present/absent, verdict prose) rather than colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow (table cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere); desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link to this page's see-also
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires the chromestatus.com/feature/5915984063889408 self-heal link on every page; this concept links siblings only — a one-line additive fix shared by all three deviceorientation concepts.

openQuestions.title: Add a copy button for the generated snippet
openQuestions.detail: The index blurb frames the snippet as 'the exact progressive-enhancement snippet to copy' and the page heading says 'Copy this', but there is no copy-to-clipboard control — users must select the pre manually, which is clumsy on touch. Add a small copy button (remembering the global button colour-override rule) with a copied confirmation in the live status.

openQuestions.title: Verify the gate-present branch on an implementing build
openQuestions.detail: In this Chromium 141 both statics are absent, so only the legacy verdict was observed. Re-run the probe on Chrome 150+ with DeviceOrientationRequestPermission enabled (or iOS Safari) and confirm the table flips the two statics to present and the verdict switches to the gated path.

summary: A tight, honest capability-probe page for exactly the surface this feature ships — the requestPermission statics — with the correct cross-browser branch generated for developers. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): probe auto-ran with truthful absent results and the legacy verdict, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either device class. Open items: chromestatus link, a snippet copy button, amber/emerald contrast (shared design-system issue), and gate-present evidence.
